name: Jyu-Rin ~Kanraku no Kakutou Shimai~
source:
The sisters were skilled fighters, honing their skills to avenge their father's enemies. However, during the battle, the older sister was caught off guard for a moment, while the younger sister fell into a despicable trap. They were both captured and awaiting them was a storm of training to become female slaves...
The sisters, with their noble spirits, tried desperately to resist the onslaught of pleasure hell, but their mental strength was gradually eroded by pleasure...

[Translated from [url=https://2dgen.com/work/d_048251]DMM[/url]]
translation:
姐妹俩都是熟练的战士，磨练她们的技能来为父亲的敌人报仇。然而战斗中，姐姐一时措手不及，而妹妹却陷入了卑鄙的陷阱。她们双双被捕，等待她们的是一场成为女奴隶的训练风暴……
姐妹俩以高贵的精神，拼命抵抗享乐地狱的侵袭，但她们的精神力却逐渐被享乐侵蚀……
